faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Nagaland Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Nagaland is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E. / M. Tech / M.S / M.Sc or equivalent degree in specific engineering or physics fields with at least 60% marks and a valid GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Nagaland will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, along with an additional 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIT Nagaland Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Nagaland.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Nagaland located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Nagaland is located in Chumukedima, Nagaland, with the pincode 797103.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Junior Research Fellow recruitment is NIT-N/Advt/PAIR/JRF/0003/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age limits and any applicable age relaxation.
